description: Lightweight, dependency-free, streaming .xlsx writer for .NET. A modern alternative to EPPlus for creating Excel files.

Guards an MCP endpoint served over streamable HTTP: any Origin header is refused (the DNS-rebinding guard), and a bearer token is required, compared in fixed time, failing closed when none is configured. Native AOT compatible.
